name: ESO 021-G004 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 021-G004, a spiral galaxy with an active galactic nucleus, seen by Hubble.
label: eso21g004-hubble
story: A swirling mass of gas, dust and stars, whose blazing heart is fed by material falling toward a supermassive black hole.

claims.text: It has an active galactic nucleus
The nucleus is powered by material falling toward a supermassive black hole
Its nucleus is classed as Seyfert (program target description)
Program 15181 is an AGN study (AGN Before and After) and the pointing is ESO 021-G004
